title: Acquire owned GP8 protection-mode fixtures and error receipts
scope: Characterize actual GP8 protected-container behavior with a finite, known-credential fixture package. Separate edit locking from opening protection before defining any parser API or error contract. This is external evidence acquisition and is excluded from agent-ready implementation until the artifacts exist.
acceptance: Create one original minimal score and save an unprotected control, a Lock Editing variant, and a Lock Opening variant using a test-only known password. Record the authoring application version, owner permission, mode, checksums and test credential. Do not use third-party protected scores.

Using Guitar Pro, verify control opening, edit-locked read-only behavior and unlock behavior, open-locked correct-password success and wrong-password refusal. Record facts for exact fixture hashes. Include a deliberately truncated copy as a malformed-control case; do not conflate wrong password and corruption.

Inspect file prefixes and, only when the bytes actually form a ZIP, member names/flags and member readability. Report observed wrapping/encryption behavior without assuming a ZIP encryption scheme from the file extension or password UI.

Run public Go Parse/ParseWithOptions and pinned AlphaTab for all fixture modes and the malformed control; record exact error type/message and whether a score was returned. Neither API currently takes credentials, so do not claim their failures characterize correct-password decryption.

Deliver authorized fixtures and canonical database receipts. Propose a bounded follow-up only if observed container evidence and an independent reader define the correct-password, wrong-password, unsupported-protection and malformed-input outcomes. If the authoring/consumer package cannot be acquired, leave the named inputs missing and keep the task out of ready_work; do not invent signatures or repeat generic research.
exclusions: No password bypass, cryptanalysis, third-party locked files, automated credential guessing, API design from guessed encryption, or oracle upgrade.
No support promotion from ordinary ZIP errors or successful parsing of an edit-locked control.

reproduction.instructions: Run go test ./integration -run TestGP8ProtectionEvidence and ALPHATAB_CONFORMANCE=1 go test . -run TestConformanceWholeCorpusAccounting. The hash-bound original Guitar Pro fixtures, authoring observations, credentials, member metadata and independent receipts are in conformance/capabilities/evidence/protection/. The truncated fixture is exactly the first 64 bytes of the unprotected control. No public Go or pinned AlphaTab API in this evidence takes credentials.

external_inputs.requirement: Owned minimal plain, Lock Editing and Lock Opening GP8 files, known test-only credential, authoring version, permission and file hashes.
external_inputs.acquisition: A licensed Guitar Pro user creates the same original score and saves each protection mode using File > Lock/Unlock. Request this exact finite package from the repository owner if local authoring access is unavailable.

external_inputs.requirement: Independent Guitar Pro results tied to the fixture hashes for each mode, correct password, wrong password and malformed/truncated control.
external_inputs.acquisition: Use the fixture authoring application with the known test password; record mode-specific open/edit outcomes. Stop after the specified matrix and report missing cases rather than trying alternate schemes or unknown credentials.

evidence.detail: needs-evidence: No known-credential protected fixture or characterized container/oracle exists; there is no bounded implementation contract.

Obtain a protected Guitar Pro fixture with known credentials and authoritative evidence for its container structure. Distinguish ZIP encryption, an encrypted member and a Guitar Pro wrapper before selecting an implementation. Provide a retaining independent consumer/oracle and expected results for correct credentials, wrong credentials and malformed data. Those facts define the required API/error contract. Until those artifacts exist, keep this out of the implementation queue and retain contextual parse failures. Record the exact evidence blocker rather than speculating about an encryption scheme.
Uses ordinary archive/zip and contextual opening/reading score.gpif errors; there is no credential parameter or proven protected-file branch.
ParseOptions has diagnostic policy only, not passwords.

Verified 2026-09-11. File > Lock/Unlock distinguishes Finalize, Lock Editing and Lock Opening. Only the latter requires a password to open. This establishes an acquisition route, not the container encoding.
Password Locked Files is unsupported; no independent decryption behavior may be inferred from ordinary ZIP parsing.

Get the three owned variants and independent outcomes first. Do not implement protection detection or decryption from guesses. The existing parser error boundary remains unchanged until actual file evidence justifies a follow-up.

All three complete variants are readable ZIP containers. No ZIP member has the encryption flag set. Both locked score.gpif members are readable as bytes but are not XML; editLocked/openLocked names distinguish these authored variants. This does not identify a cryptographic algorithm, key derivation, universal signature, or decryption API.
Hash-bound Parse/ParseWithOptions exact errors, score presence, original score content and independently inspected member metadata.
Pinned AlphaTab 1.8.4 exact errors and score presence for all four fixtures; no credential support.

resolution: Fixture-acquisition evidence delivered; awaiting fresh acceptance review. Import remains unsupported for both locked variants; no protected score reaches the public model or export. The malformed control is separate invalid data. Guitar Pro supplies mode-specific independent opening/unlocking evidence. A programmatic decryption implementation remains undefined because the member encoding and credential derivation are unknown. No decryption or password API is proposed and capability ratings remain missing. Fresh independent acceptance review and integrated full gates passed. The issue remains open with solved label for subsequent verification.
